meta.actionKo: 가래를 묽게 하여 배출을 돕는 점액용해 거담제입니다.
meta.actionEn: A mucolytic expectorant that thins phlegm and helps cough it up.

c45ae129.symEn: Mucolysis and expectoration in acute and chronic respiratory diseases
c45ae129.pointKo: 급·만성 호흡기질환의 가래 배출에 쓰는 에르도스테인 거담제입니다.
c45ae129.pointEn: An erdosteine expectorant for phlegm in acute and chronic respiratory diseases.

a9984d8b.watchKo: 과민증, 간경변, 시스타티오닌 합성효소 결핍, 소화성궤양, 중증 신장장애(크레아티닌 청소율 25 미만) 복용 금지
a9984d8b.watchEn: Do not use with hypersensitivity, liver cirrhosis, cystathionine synthase deficiency, peptic ulcers, or severe kidney disorders (creatinine clearance below 25)

en.c45ae129: This medicine is used for mucolysis (thinning mucus) and expectoration in acute and chronic respiratory diseases.
en.082b1045: Adults take 1 tablet (300 mg) per dose, 2 to 3 times a day. When taking this medicine for acute respiratory diseases, do not take it for more than 10 consecutive days.
en.a9984d8b: Do not take this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, or have liver cirrhosis, cystathionine synthase deficiency, peptic ulcers, or severe kidney disorders (creatinine clearance < 25 mL/min).
en.7dd69ce0: Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding, or have mild or moderate liver disorders.
en.afb01c81: Consult a doctor or pharmacist when taking this medicine together with cough medicines.
en.8df33f06: Headache, cold symptoms, difficulty breathing, taste abnormalities, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, upper abdominal pain, abdominal pain, heartburn, hives, redness (erythema), and eczema may occur.
